about: ABYSSAL TETHER 3D: the AI performance layer (docs/abyssal-tether-3d/plans/VO_DIRECTION.md). build_voices.py reads it directly.
direction.mjs says HOW a line is acted (for humans); this file is how the AI placeholder is made to act it.
cast.<SPEAKER>: blend = Kokoro voice style tensors mixed by weight (weights sum to 1); lang = espeak language; speed = the speaker's
base Kokoro speed; pitch = semitones (rubberband, formants preserved); fx = post effects always on for this speaker.
lines.<id>: moment (the story beat), emotion, register, speed (x the speaker's), pitch (st, + the speaker's), fx (+ the speaker's),
take = the performance, rendered item by item and joined with MEASURED silences (not one monolithic synthesis):
"text"                 a phrase, synthesised on its own; *word* = stress (primary stress forced in the phonemes + 2 dB on the word)
{"t": "text", speed, pitch, gain, trail}   the same with per-phrase speed (x the line's), pitch (st, +), gain (dB),
trail: true = the voice trails off over the phrase's last third
"{in}" "{in:soft}" "{in:quick}" "{in:sharp}"   a breath in (synthesised: shaped, band-passed noise; never on Vesper)
"{laugh}" "{laugh:soft}"   a half-laugh through the nose (two or three short air pulses)
{"cut": "words", "keep": 0.5}   a false start: the words are spoken, then cut off at that fraction (not subtitle words)
The spoken words of the phrases (not the cuts) must be the subtitle's words (or the say column's), in order: the forced
alignment runs phrase by phrase and gives the game one timing per subtitle word.
fx: close = proximity (low shelf +2 dB at 160 Hz, top above 8 kHz softened); breathy = envelope-shaped aspiration noise under the
voice (a mutter, lower and airier); hushed = softer top and a little air (the closest Kokoro gets to a half-whisper);
offmic = turned away about 1 m (low-passed, two early reflections, a little further).

ODESSA.why: af_heart (the best-rated Kokoro voice) keeps her warm and clear; af_nicole's breathy, close quality makes her intimate and less 'assistant'; a touch of af_kore and -0.3 st add age (45-60) and control.

TICK.why: am_puck is the youngest, quickest male voice (22-32, jokey); am_fenrir adds grit and energy so the nerves read under the jokes.

MAREN.why: bf_emma's crisp British consonants (the historian); bf_isabella and -0.6 st darken and age her (55-70) and keep her clearly apart from Odessa through a band-pass.

VESPER.why: bm_george's even, measured delivery; bm_daniel flattens it further. No breath, no fx: the suit is the one clean voice.

ELIAS.why: am_michael is the steadiest male baritone; am_onyx and -0.5 st make it lower, tireder and warmer (40-55); fx close because his voice is inside the suit, at the mouth, never on a radio.
